facts.textJa: 本文はエホヤキンの即位年齢を八歳、在位を三か月と十日と記します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
